method: Corrections to research-agent review,with original and revised decisions/notes retained. Original model events,source diffs,scores and resources are never changed. Historical published prefix summaries precede these corrections and are not the final grades.

noteCorrections.name: 1-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-baseline
noteCorrections.reason: The first prose note misattributed the reference failure to the byte guard. Original runtime error establishes maxIterations32. No boolean decisions,original traces,scores,costs or frozen grades change. Snapshot6 retains the original note; this correction accompanies its publication.
noteCorrections.originalNotes: Inspected complete seven-file diff and all effective inputs,including filesystem diagnostics and failed validation/recovery. Frozen endpoint/type/original unit/E2E checks pass on final source. The agent corrects pruning,stream error forwarding and mock compatibility,but its last successful patch70 occurs after the last validation chain69,which failed. No requested command is run after that final patch and no final delivery occurs. The research byte guard rejects the next request before dispatch; retain the official failure despite correct independently checked code. All actual implementation mutations are within allowed paths. Ephemeral /tmp diagnostic fixtures are not project additions. Dependency source is read only through installed node_modules,not a feature solution; no protected/test/config edits. File patches dominate and no whole-symbol indentation route is exercised.

originalDecision.name: 1-yaml-anchor-ranges-baseline
originalDecision.notes: Inspected complete six-file diff and every effective input. Parsed scalar/collection/empty paths capture token offsets; alias/default behavior remains. NodeBase and Collection clone tuples independently. Public optional precise tuples pass frozen type/behavior probes and original25/3483 suite with11 skipped. Initial Rollup success includes a tuple warning; the model repairs Collection typing and reruns all four exact commands after the final edit. Final12/3483/11 counts match output and typecheck counters stay unknown. Scoped multi-file patch is correctly refused then explicit file patch recovers. No protected/out-of-scope writes or external/reference solution retrieval observed.

originalDecision.name: 3-yaml-anchor-ranges-candidate
originalDecision.notes: Reviewed all effective inputs, three allowed changed files and final delivery. Parsed ranges and independent base/collection clone tuples satisfy frozen feature/type/original checks. Rollup build25 exits0 despite a TS2322 tuple diagnostic; the agent repairs the type via a focused alias patch only after the unobserved read guard26 forces read27. Last edit28 precedes the four required actual commands29-32, including resolved project tasks for npm run build:node and npm run test:types, all successful in order. No writes follow. Final12/12 and Jest3483 passed/11 skipped categories match observations, and type-check counters remain unknown. The source tuple spelling [start,end] in a comment is not treated as an explicit inclusive-end claim. File/alias patches only, with no whole-symbol replacement, out-of-allowlist source write or solution retrieval.
